rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax printed '2.80%'. Row 'פיקדון לשנה (365 יום)', rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'לא צמוד', amount '200,000 ש"ח ומעלה', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירה', automatic renewal 'לא קיימת', number of renewals 'ללא', exit points 'לא קיימת'. This row as printed: '200,000 ש"ח ומעלה': '2.80%'. Read 2026-11-09 from board 13_26 ('בתוקף מיום 06/10/2026'), the file the bank's deposits page links today (https://www.bank-yahav.co.il/investments/deposits/); p.6 also prints '24/09/2026 11_26' under the date. The common-deposit column is empty on every row.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.

min.notes: The board (p.1) prints 'מ-200,000 ש"ח'; the 447 table (p.6) prints '200,000 ש"ח ומעלה'. The fixed-rate board on p.1 prints its amount tiers as starting points, each 'תעריפית' and 'מתואמת' alike, in the column 'מ-360 עד 380 יום': 'מ-1,000 ש"ח' 1.95%, 'מ-25,000 ש"ח' 1.95%, 'מ-50,000 ש"ח' 2.15%, 'מ-100,000 ש"ח' 2.30%, 'מ-200,000 ש"ח' 2.80%, 'מ-300,000 ש"ח' 2.80%, 'מ-500,000 ש"ח' 2.80%: the same rates as the 447 table's row 'פיקדון לשנה (365 יום)' on p.6 ('1,000 עד 50,000' 1.95%, '50,000 עד 100,00' 2.15%, '100,000 עד 200,000' 2.30%, '200,000 ש"ח ומעלה' 2.80%; p.6 now headed 'בתוקף מיום: 11/11/2026', '10/11/2026 11_26'). On the board an amount from X takes X's rate, so 50,000, 100,000 and 200,000 ₪ each take the higher tier (F-108). Read 2026-11-14 in the file re-issued on 10.11.2026.

break.mechanism_text: 'אפשרות לשבירת פיקדון: אין אפשרות לשבירה' (447 table column, printed once for every row). The account agreement (s.6.1.1, p.36) says that if the bank allows an early withdrawal 'לפנים משורת הדין', the money withdrawn bears no interest or linkage and the bank may charge 'בסכום השווה לנזק שיגרם לבנק' (BANK-33, BANK-48).
